files.description: One AP242 part: a BREP_WITH_VOIDS solid, the box (0, 0, 0) to (20, 20, 20) less the closed cavity (2, 2, 2) to (18, 18, 18); every wall is 2 mm thick and all twelve faces are full planar rectangles.
